Stop orphaned Paperclip worker sessions from replaying stale ComfyUI jobs
description: Observed during HOL-17/HOL-18 fresh proof reruns on the 3090. Multiple orphaned Hermes worker processes for the same Paperclip agent remained alive after issue completion/cancellation and continued to submit stale lip-sync prompts (e.g. elder_man_paperclip_lipsync_v2/v3) into ComfyUI. This caused duplicate queue entries, blocked unrelated fresh proofs, and required manual process kills plus queue/service cleanup. Need a control-plane fix so stale worker runs are terminated exactly once and cannot keep replaying old issue work after the issue is done or the run is cancelled.
notes: Root cause confirmed in live 3090 install: hermes-paperclip-adapter and the generic process adapter were not forwarding ctx.onSpawn into runChildProcess(), so heartbeat rows never persisted processPid/processGroupId for Hermes children. That left pre-fix runs impossible to terminate after server restart or run-state loss. Applied live patch on 3090, collapsed duplicate Paperclip servers back to one managed systemd user instance on 127.0.0.1:3100, and verified new run ca8e883c/948d68dd persisted processPid+processGroupId and exited cleanly after issue shutdown.
close_reason: Live 3090 fix verified: new Hermes runs now persist processPid/processGroupId and stop cleanly after issue shutdown.

title: Stabilize Paperclip manual-owner status persistence and comment wake behavior
description: Observed during HOL-18/HOL-19 manual local-board reruns. Manual takeover needed a non-agent owner to avoid Hermes wakes, but assignee/status persistence was inconsistent on immediate reads, and comment-driven wake context around HOL-17 still queued extra runs despite manual reconciliation. Need to verify and fix: (1) local-board/manual user assignment persistence, (2) in_progress/done status read-after-write consistency, and (3) suppression of non-actionable local-board comments from creating or preserving queued worker runs.
notes: Root cause 1: local-board proof report suppression was incomplete. routes/issues.js only skipped assignee wake for PATCH /issues/:id with comment=..., not POST /issues/:id/comments, and both routes plus heartbeat deferred-comment filtering only matched bodies starting exactly with ## Proof Report. Live fix: broaden proof detection to body includes "proof report", suppress implicit reopen for those local-board comments, and apply the same no-wake behavior in POST /issues/:id/comments. Root cause 2: manual takeover left stale queued/running assignment work for the old assignee. Live fix: added heartbeat.cancelIssueAgentWork(issueId, agentId, reason) to cancel queued/deferred wakeups and queued/running runs for the previous assignee, and call it from routes/issues.js whenever an issue moves off an agent assignee. Verification on 3090: Case A (HOL-26) local-board proof-style comment on an agent-owned issue left only the original issue_assigned run; no issue_commented wake was created. Case B (HOL-27) reassignment to assigneeUserId=local-board persisted immediately on both PATCH response and immediate GET, and the pre-existing issue_assigned wake moved to cancelled instead of surviving the handoff. Cleaned scratch HOL-21..HOL-27 and confirmed no live scratch runs remained.
close_reason: Live 3090 fix verified: local-board proof comments no longer wake/reopen agent work, and manual handoff cancels stale old-assignee wakes/runs.

title: Stop missing_issue_comment recovery on cancelled agent-owned issues
description: During .openclaw-3ut scratch cleanup, cancelling an agent-owned issue after its assignment run had started could still spawn a follow-up heartbeat run with wakeReason=missing_issue_comment on the already-cancelled issue. Example scratch path: HOL-26 cancelled, assignment run e0c1f45a cancelled, then retry run cddd2fac queued/running with issue status already cancelled. The issue was neutralized by reassigning it to local-board, but the control plane should refuse missing_issue_comment continuation/retry work for terminal issues.
notes: Root cause: heartbeat.enqueueMissingIssueCommentRetry() only re-locked by execution_run_id and never revalidated the current issue row, so it could queue a missing_issue_comment retry even after the issue had been moved to a terminal state. Live fix on 3090 in services/heartbeat.js: after selecting the issue row for the retry path, require that (a) status is not done/cancelled and (b) assigneeAgentId still matches the run agent before inserting a retry wake/run. Verification on 3090 with scratch HOL-28: created an agent-owned scratch issue, waited for its issue_assigned run, cancelled the issue while it was still agent-owned, cancelled the live run, and inspected all heartbeat runs for the issue. Result: only the original issue_assigned run remained, in cancelled state; no run with wakeReason or retryReason missing_issue_comment was created. Scratch issue was then neutralized to cancelled + local-board with no live runs remaining.
close_reason: Live 3090 fix verified: cancelled terminal issues no longer spawn missing_issue_comment recovery runs.
